description: CD34_PRM_Chaufferie_SARF is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivités forestières Occitanie Pyrénées-Méditerranée dans le cadre de l'Observatoire Interrégional Bois-énergie Occitanie. Localisation des chaufferies bois dans l'Hérault (2026). Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Territoires, Agriculture et Innovations. Its keywords are SARF, chaufferie. The portal shows 126 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
